components.name: SHA family

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha.js@2.4.12 is a declared production dependency (package.json:147, locked in bun.lock:1855) providing pure-JS SHA-1/224/256/384/512. Live call site: src/state/Send.ts:40 imports it and Send.ts:435 does `sha("sha256").update(preimage).digest()` to derive a Lightning payment hash from a preimage. SHA-256 is Grover-only (square-root), not Shor-vulnerable; rating D appropriate. No urgent action; SHA-384/SHA3 only if CNSA 2.0 compliance is ever a goal.
